objective.en: Track Hurricane Ida's heaviest rain bands so pump and levee crews know where water will rise.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 18% of peak daily GPM IMERG precipitation rate during Hurricane Ida's landfall on 29-30 August 2021 (2021-08-29..2021-08-31). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its event total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.82 for this storm setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
